# Jared Russell

> Data Engineer and AI Concierge at Ruckus Systems.

## About
Jared Russell builds robust data pipelines, automation systems, and practical AI solutions. Based in North Carolina, he works on healthcare data engineering at HealthBook+ and leads engineering at Ruckus Systems.
